requirements.text: The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The library management system shall provide an annual report on energy usage and sustainability performance.
The library management system shall enable digital notifications for overdue books to reduce paper waste and ensure accountability.
The library management system shall allow members to check the carbon footprint of each book based on its lifecycle impact.
The library management system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
The library management system shall ensure that only authenticated members can borrow or return books.
The library management system shall log all borrowing transactions for auditability purposes.
The library management system shall enforce data encryption for all member personal information stored.
The library management system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The library management system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The library management system shall allow a maximum of 5 simultaneous borrow operations to ensure fair resource allocation.
The library management system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The library management system shall implement a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The library management system shall track overdue books and notify members within 24 hours of the due date.
The library management system shall track energy savings achieved through digital operations compared to traditional methods.
The library management system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.
